topics.title: Generally Accepted Accounting Principles
topics.tag: One rulebook: the Codification is the only authoritative source of nongovernmental US GAAP.

topics.title: Presentation of Financial Statements
topics.tag: Tell a comparable story — separate what is gone (discontinued ops) and warn if the entity may not survive (going concern).

topics.title: Balance Sheet
topics.tag: A snapshot of what you own and owe — classified by liquidity, never netted without a legal right of setoff.

topics.title: Statement of Shareholder Equity
topics.tag: Reconcile beginning-to-ending equity — the bridge between two balance sheets.

topics.title: Income Statement—Reporting Comprehensive Income
topics.tag: Net income plus the parked value changes (OCI) — and, from 2027, disaggregated expense captions.

topics.title: Income Statement
topics.tag: Legacy home of income-statement guidance — now superseded and moved into Topic 220 (220-20, 220-30).

topics.title: Statement of Cash Flows
topics.tag: Explain the change in cash — operating, investing and financing — including restricted cash.

topics.title: Notes to Financial Statements
topics.tag: Disclose the accounting policies that materially drive the numbers.

topics.title: Accounting Changes and Error Corrections
topics.tag: Principle changes and errors go back in time (retrospective); estimate changes go forward (prospective).

topics.title: Changing Prices
topics.tag: Optional disclosure of inflation and changing-price effects on a business.

topics.title: Earnings Per Share
topics.tag: Earnings per share: profit for each common share, basic and fully diluted.

topics.title: Interim Reporting
topics.tag: Quarterly reports are an integral part of the annual period, not mini-years.

topics.title: Limited Liability Entities
topics.tag: LLCs report like their structure: members' equity, no LLC-level tax unless it applies.

topics.title: Personal Financial Statements
topics.tag: Personal financial statements: individuals present assets at estimated current value, not cost.

topics.title: Risks and Uncertainties
topics.tag: Disclose the risks that could hit you hard and soon: estimates and concentrations.

topics.title: Segment Reporting
topics.tag: Show the business through management's eyes: reportable segments and significant segment expenses.

topics.title: Cash and Cash Equivalents
topics.tag: Cash and cash equivalents — the money you can spend today (legacy Topic; guidance now in 230 and the Master Glossary).

topics.title: Receivables
topics.tag: Receivables and loans at amortized cost — fees and costs become yield, troubled loans get special treatment.
subtopics: 30 Loans and Debt Securities Acquired with Deteriorated Credit Quality

topics.title: Investments—Debt Securities
topics.tag: Debt securities by intent: trading (FV-NI), available-for-sale (FV-OCI), held-to-maturity (amortized cost).

topics.title: Investments—Equity Securities
topics.tag: Equity securities at fair value through net income — or cost minus impairment if no readily determinable fair value.

topics.title: Investments—Equity Method and Joint Ventures
topics.tag: Significant influence (≈20%) → equity method: carry your share of the investee's book equity and earnings.
subtopics: 30 Partnerships, Joint Ventures, and Limited Liability Entities

topics.title: Investments—Other
topics.tag: Everything else you invest in: cost-method legacy items, insurance contracts (COLI) and securitization beneficial interests.
subtopics: 40 Beneficial Interests in Securitized Financial Assets

topics.title: Financial Instruments—Credit Losses
topics.tag: CECL: book the lifetime expected credit loss on day one — don't wait for the default.

topics.title: Inventory
topics.tag: Inventory at cost, written down to net realizable value when it won't sell for what it cost.

topics.title: Other Assets and Deferred Costs
topics.tag: Prepaids and deferred costs — pay now, expense as the benefit is used; capitalize contract-acquisition costs.
subtopics: 30 Insurance Contracts That Do Not Transfer Insurance Risk

topics.title: Intangibles—Goodwill and Other
topics.tag: Goodwill (impairment-only), finite-lived intangibles (amortize), internal-use software and crypto (fair value).

topics.title: Property, Plant, and Equipment
topics.tag: PP&E at cost, depreciated over useful life; impaired only when undiscounted cash flows can't recover it.

topics.title: Liabilities
topics.tag: Liabilities: book what you owe; derecognize only when paid or legally released.
subtopics: 40 Obligations Resulting from Joint and Several Liability Arrangements

topics.title: Asset Retirement and Environmental Obligations
topics.tag: If the law makes you clean up when you retire an asset, book the obligation now — at fair value.

topics.title: Exit or Disposal Cost Obligations
topics.tag: Exit and disposal costs: book them when incurred — not when management merely plans them.

topics.title: Deferred Revenue
topics.tag: Deferred revenue: cash received before you've earned it is a liability (link Topic → ASC 606).

topics.title: Commitments
topics.tag: Commitments: disclose big promises you've made even if nothing is owed yet.

topics.title: Contingencies
topics.tag: Loss contingencies: accrue if probable AND estimable; disclose if reasonably possible; never book gains early.

topics.title: Guarantees
topics.tag: Guarantees: the guarantor books a liability at inception for the stand-ready obligation — even if payout is unlikely.

topics.title: Debt
topics.tag: Debt: classify by callability, modify vs. extinguish with the 10% test, participation features at fair value.
subtopics: 20 Debt with Conversion and Other Options

topics.title: Distinguishing Liabilities from Equity
topics.tag: Some 'shares' are really debt: mandatorily redeemable instruments and fixed-value settlement obligations are liabilities.

topics.title: Equity
topics.tag: Equity: owners' residual claim — contributions, distributions, treasury stock, splits and spinoffs.

topics.title: Revenue Recognition
topics.tag: Legacy revenue Topic — nearly all guidance superseded by ASC 606; remnants for provisions for losses and non-customer contracts.

topics.title: Revenue from Contracts with Customers
topics.tag: The five-step model: revenue when control of a promised good or service transfers, at the amount you expect to be entitled to.

topics.title: Other Income
topics.tag: Other income: gains on selling nonfinancial assets (610-20) and involuntary conversions (610-30).
subtopics: 20 Gains and Losses from the Derecognition of Nonfinancial Assets
30 Gains and Losses on Involuntary Conversions

topics.title: Cost of Sales and Services
topics.tag: Cost of sales and vendor consideration: rebates from suppliers usually reduce cost, not boost revenue.
subtopics: 20 Accounting for Consideration Received from a Vendor

topics.title: Compensation—General
topics.tag: Compensation: accrue earned wages, bonuses and compensated absences (PTO) as employees work.

topics.title: Compensation—Nonretirement Postemployment Benefits
topics.tag: Nonretirement postemployment benefits (severance, disability, continuation) — accrue when earned or when probable.

topics.title: Compensation—Retirement Benefits
topics.tag: Retirement benefits: defined benefit plans book the funded status; defined contribution plans expense the contribution.

topics.title: Compensation—Stock Compensation
topics.tag: Stock comp: measure equity awards at grant-date fair value and expense over the service period.

topics.title: Other Expenses
topics.tag: Other expenses: start-up costs, insurance, property taxes, advertising — mostly expensed as incurred.
subtopics: 50 Fees Paid to the Federal Government by Pharmaceutical Manufacturers and Health Insurers

topics.title: Research and Development
topics.tag: Research and development: expense as incurred — future benefits are too uncertain to capitalize.

topics.title: Income Taxes
topics.tag: Income taxes: current tax + deferred tax on temporary differences; uncertain positions need 'more likely than not'.

topics.title: Business Combinations
topics.tag: Business combinations at fair value with goodwill — but most property purchases are asset acquisitions (no goodwill).
subtopics: 20 Identifiable Assets and Liabilities, and Any Noncontrolling Interest
30 Goodwill or Gain from Bargain Purchase, Including Consideration Transferred

topics.title: Collaborative Arrangements
topics.tag: Collaborative arrangements: two active partners sharing risks — not automatically customer revenue.

topics.title: Consolidation
topics.tag: Consolidation: control decides — voting interest model or VIE model (power + economics = primary beneficiary).
subtopics: 20 Control of Partnerships and Similar Entities

topics.title: Derivatives and Hedging
topics.tag: Derivatives at fair value; hedge accounting lets matched risks offset in the same period.

topics.title: Environmental Credits and Environmental Credit Obligations
topics.tag: Environmental credits and obligations (new Topic): compliance credits at cost, obligations as emissions occur.

topics.title: Fair Value Measurement
topics.tag: Fair value = exit price to market participants; disclose the Level 1/2/3 hierarchy of inputs.

topics.title: Financial Instruments
topics.tag: Financial instruments: fair value option, fair value disclosures, and credit-risk concentration disclosures.

topics.title: Foreign Currency Matters
topics.tag: Foreign currency: remeasure transactions at spot (gains in earnings); translate foreign operations (CTA in OCI).

topics.title: Government Assistance
topics.tag: Government assistance: disclose grants today; ASU 2025-10 adds a recognition model for business-entity grants (pending).

topics.title: Interest
topics.tag: Interest: capitalize it during construction, impute it on below-market notes, amortize debt costs by effective interest.

topics.title: Leases
topics.tag: Legacy lease accounting (operating vs. capital leases) — superseded by ASC 842.

topics.title: Leases
topics.tag: Leases: lessees put a right-of-use asset and lease liability on the books; lessors recognize rent straight-line.

topics.title: Nonmonetary Transactions
topics.tag: Nonmonetary exchanges at fair value — unless the swap lacks commercial substance.

topics.title: Reference Rate Reform
topics.tag: Reference rate reform (LIBOR → SOFR) relief — expired after 2024; paragraphs now superseded.

topics.title: Related Party Disclosures
topics.tag: Related parties: disclose transactions with insiders because they can't be presumed arm's-length.

topics.title: Reorganizations
topics.tag: Reorganizations: Chapter 11 reporting, fresh-start accounting and quasi-reorganizations.

topics.title: Service Concession Arrangements
topics.tag: Service concessions: operating public infrastructure for a government doesn't make it your PP&E.

topics.title: Subsequent Events
topics.tag: Subsequent events: adjust for conditions that existed at year-end; disclose new ones that arose after.

topics.title: Transfers and Servicing
topics.tag: Transfers of financial assets: a sale only if you surrender control; otherwise it's a secured borrowing.
subtopics: 40 Transfers to Qualifying Special Purpose Entities

topics.title: Agriculture
topics.tag: Agriculture: growing crops and animals are inventory-like costs; cooperatives and patrons have special rules.

topics.title: Airlines
topics.tag: Airlines: industry scope for revenue cycle, flight equipment and maintenance (overview in this source).

topics.title: Contractors—Construction
topics.tag: Construction contractors: contract costs, use rates for equipment, and retainage — revenue itself follows 606.

topics.title: Contractors—Federal Government
topics.tag: Federal government contractors: cost-plus contracts, allowable costs and terminations.

topics.title: Development Stage Entities
topics.tag: Development stage entities — reporting requirements removed (ASU 2014-15); Topic is status-only.

topics.title: Entertainment—Broadcasters
topics.tag: Broadcasters: program rights and barter — Topic overview (industry subtopics referenced).

topics.title: Entertainment—Cable Television
topics.tag: Cable television: prematurity period and system construction costs — Topic overview.

topics.title: Entertainment—Casinos
topics.tag: Casinos: gaming chips, promotional allowances and base-jackpot accruals — Topic overview.

topics.title: Entertainment—Films
topics.tag: Films: capitalize film costs, amortize using individual-film-forecast, test for impairment.

topics.title: Entertainment—Music
topics.tag: Music: advances to artists and license fees for masters and copyrights — Topic overview.

topics.title: Extractive Activities—Mining
topics.tag: Mining: exploration, development and production phases; stripping costs are production costs.

topics.title: Extractive Activities—Oil and Gas
topics.tag: Oil and gas: successful efforts vs. full cost; reserves disclosures (SEC).

topics.title: Financial Services—Brokers and Dealers
topics.tag: Broker-dealers: trade-date accounting, fair value of securities inventory and segregation of customer funds.

topics.title: Financial Services—Depository and Lending
topics.tag: Banks and lenders: industry presentation (SEC Article 9) — Topic overview with SEC materials.

topics.title: Financial Services—Insurance
topics.tag: Insurance: premiums earned over coverage, claims reserves, deferred acquisition costs and LDTI.
subtopics: 40 Claim Costs and Liabilities for Future Policy Benefits

topics.title: Financial Services—Investment Companies
topics.tag: Investment companies: everything at fair value, no consolidation of portfolio companies (real estate funds often qualify).

topics.title: Financial Services—Mortgage Banking
topics.tag: Mortgage banking: loans held for sale at lower of cost or fair value; servicing rights recognized.

topics.title: Financial Services—Title Plant
topics.tag: Title plant: the historical land-records database is capitalized and not depreciated (950-350).

topics.title: Franchisors
topics.tag: Franchisors: franchise fees under 606 (pre-opening services practical expedient) and franchise costs.

topics.title: Health Care Entities
topics.tag: Health care entities: patient revenue net of implicit price concessions; industry presentation.

topics.title: Not-for-Profit Entities
topics.tag: Not-for-profits: net assets with/without donor restrictions; contributions vs. exchanges.

topics.title: Plan Accounting—Defined Benefit Pension Plans
topics.tag: Defined benefit pension plan accounting: net assets available for benefits and accumulated plan benefits.
subtopics: 30 Net Assets Available for Plan Benefits

topics.title: Plan Accounting—Defined Contribution Pension Plans
topics.tag: Defined contribution plan accounting (401(k)): net assets available for benefits at fair value.

topics.title: Plan Accounting—Health and Welfare Benefit Plans
topics.tag: Health and welfare benefit plan accounting: benefit obligations including IBNR claims.
subtopics: 20 Net Assets Available for Plan Benefits

topics.title: Real Estate—General
topics.tag: Real estate—General: capitalize project costs (preacquisition, taxes, insurance, amenities), allocate them, and account for syndications.

topics.title: Real Estate—Common Interest Realty Associations
topics.tag: Common interest realty associations (HOAs, condo associations): funds for future major repairs and common property.

topics.title: Real Estate—Real Estate Investment Trusts
topics.tag: REITs: distribute 90% of taxable income, disclose tax status of distributions, follow SEC Rule 3-15.

topics.title: Real Estate—Retail Land
topics.tag: Retail land sales: volume sales of subdivided lots with seller financing (revenue now under 606).

topics.title: Real Estate—Time-Sharing Activities
topics.tag: Time-sharing: account for each phase separately; uncollectibility reduces revenue; heavy selling costs.

topics.title: Regulated Operations
topics.tag: Regulated operations: rate regulation can turn costs into regulatory assets (and refunds into regulatory liabilities).

topics.title: Software
topics.tag: Software for sale: expense until technological feasibility, then capitalize and amortize.
subtopics: 20 Costs of Software to Be Sold, Leased, or Marketed

topics.title: U.S. Steamship Entities
topics.tag: U.S. steamship entities: legacy deferred-tax guidance on statutory reserve deposits — now superseded (995-740).
